info.title: Docswrite Public API
info.description: Public REST API for publishing Google Docs to WordPress and other CMS platforms. Authenticate with an org API key (Authorization: Bearer dw_live_…; one key for every connection of the organization) or a per-site API token (x-access-token). Org-key responses carry RateLimit-Limit / RateLimit-Remaining / RateLimit-Reset headers. See /auth.md.
info.summary: The publishing API for AI agents: publish to every connected blog, CMS and social network.
info.x-api-versioning: Additive changes ship without notice. Breaking changes ship under a new path; the old operation keeps working for at least 6 months and answers with Deprecation and Sunset headers meanwhile.

get.description: Liveness check for the Docswrite API. No authentication. Returns 200 when the API is up.

post.summary: Publish a Google Doc to WordPress
post.description: Create or update a WordPress post/page from a Google Docs document (WordPress connections only; use POST /api/posts for other CMS connections). With a per-site token the token's site is the target. With an org API key, name the target with connection_id. Returns a job id; the publish runs asynchronously (poll /api/job/status with queueType "post").

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe publishing: the first response is stored for 24 h and replayed (Idempotent-Replayed: true) for the same key and body. A different body → 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; still running → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.

connection_id.description: Target connection id (GET /api/connections). Required with an org API key (or site_id / sub_domain); ignored for per-site tokens.

sub_domain.description: The connection's internal sub_domain (alternative to connection_id).

google_docs_url.description: URL of the source Google Doc.

date.description: Publish date (ISO); a future date schedules the post.

post.summary: Publish content (Markdown or HTML) to one or more connections
post.description: Agents send the post itself: title + Markdown or HTML (+ excerpt, tags, categories, slug, SEO, canonical URL, images). One request publishes to many connections (WordPress, the WordPress plugin, Webflow, Contentful, Shopify, GitHub, Ghost, Medium, Dev.to, Hashnode, hosted blogs, X, LinkedIn) as a draft, now, or scheduled. A Google Doc (google_doc_url) is an alternative source. Returns one result per connection; follow ids with GET /api/v1/posts/{id}. 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED (with billing_url) when the Free plan's posts are used up.
